{"id":1962354718,"question_id":4267,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774752130,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1962354718/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Design Event Manager","memory":"N/A","code":"class EventManager {\npublic:\n    unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n    set<pair<int,int>>st;\n    EventManager(vector<vector<int>>& events) {\n        for(auto it : events){\n            int id = it[0];\n            int prio = it[1];\n            mp[id] = prio;\n            st.insert({-prio , id});\n        }\n    }\n    \n    void updatePriority(int eventId, int newPriority) {\n        int oldprio = mp[eventId];\n        st.erase({oldprio , eventId});\n        mp[eventId] = newPriority;\n        st.insert({-newPriority , eventId});\n    }\n    \n    int pollHighest() {\n        if(st.empty()) return -1;\n        auto first = st.begin();\n        int id = first->second;\n        st.erase(first);\n        mp.erase(id);\n        return id;\n    }\n};\n\n/**\n * Your EventManager object will be instantiated and called as such:\n * EventManager* obj = new EventManager(events);\n * obj->updatePriority(eventId,newPriority);\n * int param_2 = obj->pollHighest();\n */","compare_result":"","title_slug":"design-event-manager","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1887}
